messages:
sam: Nightly evals flagged a spike in toolcall schema failures on q4_0-nightly. ~12/200 prompts failed where the tool got a stringified kwargs blob instead of an object. cc @mohan @jess

eval-bot: nightly-eval job: https://ci/redwood/nightly/19456 - 12 fails, failure rate 6%. First failure sample attached below.

eval-bot: ```json
{"prompt_id": "prompt_082", "model": "q4_0-nightly", "tool_output": "{\"action\": \"lookup\", \"kwargs\": \"{\\\"top_k\\\":10,\\\"timeout\\\":5}\"}"}
```

jess: ugh, so tool_output.kwargs is a stringified JSON inside the tool_output string? :thinking_face:

sam: yeah exactly. expected: 
```json
{"action":"lookup","kwargs":{"top_k":10,"timeout":5}}
```

mohan: can repro locally with the nightly image and eval harness. running a quick generator trace now to capture raw tokens + postprocess.

anya: did this start after the kvcache compaction PR merged? iirc that touched streaming/stop-token handling and a tiny bit of postprocessing.

liam: also saw a similar symptom in a customer case — generator injected extra escaping in function outputs when temperature > 0.3. maybe generator-level escaping + formatter combine to double-escape?

mohan: interesting — my trace shows tokens: 
```
... "{","\\",""","t","o","p","_","k",""","\":","1","0","...
```
so the model is emitting backslash escapes before quotes, which then survive into the tool payload.

jess: is this only q4_0-nightly? any regressions on q8 or cpu-hosted?

sam: quick matrix: q8 stable = no failure. q4 stable (pre-nightly) = no failure. q4_0-nightly = fail. dedicated infra tests also fail when run with nightly build.

anya: could be a tokenizer serialization change in nightly compilation that affects how we write string tokens vs raw json. any diffs in tokenizer version?

mohan: diffing the model commits now. small change in the decode path around escape normalization in commit 9f3a2b. pinging runtime folks.

liam: pragmatic triage: we can add a tolerant coercer in the tool marshal layer that attempts json.loads on string kwargs, but we should log and alert when coercion happened so we don't silently hide model regressions.

jess: Agreed. add a short-term acceptance path + metric. Long term: fix model so it emits proper objects when using function/tool calling.

sam: action items: 1) mohan to attach raw token traces and failing examples to a ticket; 2) jess to add a transient schema coercion + metric in the tool caller (hotfix) ; 3) runtime team to bisect commit 9f3a2b (anya to loop them in). i'll create the ticket and assign.

mohan: uploading traces now -> https://s3.redwood/triage/q4-nightly-token-trace-1945678901.log ; included 6 failing snippets.

jess: i'll open PR for coercer + telemetry. small patch: in tool_caller.process_output(): 
```py
if isinstance(kwargs_field, str):
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(kwargs_field)
        metric.increment('toolcall.kwargs_coerced')
        kwargs_field = parsed
    except Exception:
        raise SchemaValidationError('kwargs not parseable')
```
we should also attach model build id and sample to metric.

anya: pinging @eng-runtime to look at 9f3a2b now. tagging infra oncall. :eyes:

liam: sounds good. prefer short-term coercion so customers don't break. long term fix on model side.

sam: thanks all — i'll track in the ticket. will update this thread after the bisect. :thumbsup:

jess: created https://issues/redwood/ML-4312 with steps, assigned to mohan + runtime. linking PR draft when ready.

mohan: on it. starting bisect and will run focused evals per commit. expect initial findings in ~2 hours.

liam: nice. if you need infra for parallel bisects i can spin up a couple of small jobs.

sam: closing loop for now; we'll post updates here.
